evaluate lim x 0 sin 2x sin x x.solution: Split the fraction: (sin 2x + sin x)/x = (sin 2x)/x + (sin x)/x. The standard limit sin(kx)/x → k as x → 0 gives (sin 2x)/x → 2 and (sin x)/x → 1. Sum = 2 + 1 = 3, so option D.

research.name: Split the fraction
steps: Write (sin 2x + sin x)/x as sin 2x / x + sin x / x.
Use sin(kx)/x → k as x → 0: sin 2x / x → 2 and sin x / x → 1.

find the local maximum of f x 2x 3 9x 2.solution: Differentiate: f'(x) = 6x² − 18x + 12 = 6(x − 1)(x − 2), so the critical points are x = 1 and x = 2. f''(x) = 12x − 18. At x = 1, f''(1) = −6 < 0, so it is a local maximum. f(1) = 2 − 9 + 12 − 3 = 2. Option B.

research.name: Second-derivative test
steps: f''(x) = 12x − 18: f''(1) = −6 < 0 → local maximum; f''(2) = 6 > 0 → local minimum.

which indian state was formed first afte.solution: 1. After independence in 1947, demands for linguistic states grew. 2. The first state created purely on linguistic basis was Andhra Pradesh in 1953, carved from Madras Presidency for Telugu speakers. 3. Maharashtra and Gujarat were formed in 1960; Karnataka (as Mysore) was reorganised in 1956. 4. Hence, Andhra Pradesh was the first linguistic state post-independence.

research.name: Timeline Comparison
steps: List formation years of each option: Andhra Pradesh (1953), Karnataka (1956), Maharashtra & Gujarat (1960).
Identify the earliest year among them.
Confirm that Andhra Pradesh (1953) predates all others.
Conclude Andhra Pradesh is the first linguistic state.
